define.basis: Authored restricted contract from recovered R081 title, now explicitly scaled to 256x256 and 512x512; actual compressed input, optimized CPU comparator, equivalent final planar output, cold and amortized persistent gates predeclared.

prepare.basis: Generated actual MPEG2 streams; separate Python/JS entropy observers agree; host FFmpeg provides 33 independent decoded pictures per size. Regeneration paths, licenses and identities captured.

screen.basis: Strengthened beyond the prior 64x64 screen: actual 256x256 and 512x512 MPEG2 DC-I plus 32 chroma-aligned motion-only P pictures now parse from compressed bytes in both timed browser paths. All 33 independently FFmpeg-decoded pictures per size and all 88 timed outputs match exactly. Wrong DC/motion, restored source state, mismatched dimensions and closed owners are checked. Optimized CPU uses coalesced typed-array row copies, with reusable buffers in the persistent case. Cold median GPU/CPU ratios are 2.078947 and 1.887640; persistent warm medians 1.656250 and 1.818182, and setup+11jobs+teardown totals 1.704023 and 1.783516. Zero GPU-faster pairs in all four 11-pair sets. This is a measured scoped negative for actual software entropy plus GPU partial reconstruction, not a postdecode-copy substitution or universal GPU-decoder conclusion.

correctness.basis: All 33 CPU/GPU pictures per size and all 88 timed outputs exact versus independent FFmpeg. Wrong DC and motion change output; valid replay restores state; dimension mismatch, closed owner and truncated syntax reject.

performance.basis: 11 alternating cold pairs and 11 alternating persistent pairs per size in quiet coordinated window. Actual source entropy parse and required final readback charged. Cold ratios 2.078947/1.887640; warm 1.656250/1.818182; persistent including setup and teardown totals 1.704023/1.783516. No faster GPU pair, failing <=0.95 and >=9/11 gates.
